title: NLTK: Untrusted search path in prover9/mace4 config allows local code execution via relative binary_location…
description: NLTK versions up to 3.10.3 have a vulnerability in the prover9 and mace4 configuration that allows local code execution when a relative binary_location is used. The issue arises because the code accepts relative paths for the prover9/mace4 binaries without validating that they are absolute paths, leading to execution of attacker-planted binaries in the current working directory. This flaw is due to missing path validation that other similar components in NLTK enforce. A fix is available in version 3.10.4, which rejects relative binary locations and enforces absolute-only paths.
